PRESENT:

- Emandyr

Horus looks at you and smiles, "You look well, I'm sorry about the dreams, a symptom of our... longevity."
Kairos looks over at Horus with distain, "A product of insolence. I gave you my knowledge but none of my fury. Return to me Ivys, and we can make right everything that has been done to us."

Horus just wants to talk about Ivys, he isn't worried about anything to do with past lives or Kairos' plans. 
- How are you? 
- I saw you learned a new spell, you may just be the most talented of us all
- You have friends? That's good, we always had a hard time connecting...
- You deserve more, more of life than you've been given. I am so sorry for that

Kairos is hyper focused on the past, he wants Ivys to get back to the tower and finish what they started.
- You're nothing without me, none of you were. We did this together, we finish this together.
- You can go to as many festivals and wars as you want, it all ends with us, you can't run from this.
- You can't pretend for much longer. I lived far longer than you, they'll come for you the same way they came for me.

They talk for a while, Ivys can try to glean some information about the future or the past.
Information they can give him is limited, mostly because Horus doesn't want to talk about it, Kairos is desperate to get Ivys back on his side.
INFO:
- Kairos: You must find Oztar, everything, everyone, it all hinges on this.
- Horus: I know you killed Bekarys Ivys, but why did Kairos have you do it? You're going to work together we've seen it, so ask yourself this: Is it more likely you betrayed yourself for power, or that you did it for the right reason?

As they are talking the conversation will begin to end, the room starts to grow cold and Kairos' face grows concerned, he screams out "YOU CANNOT RUN FROM-" 
Another darker, more sinister voice says, "*Feeeaaar*......" ([[Azrael]])
Before he can finish, the mirror shatters and falls into glass pieces on the ground, as a shadowy figure, a body of purple and black smoke with black armor, and a hood pulled over its face, which as he pulls back the hood is revealed to be a skull, and becomes alight with red and pink flames.

"Sorry to crash the party with your past lives, or, past deaths as I like to call em."
He floats past you as he orbits the edges of the room, eventually blocking the way you entered.
"You have lived far too long Kairos, and now, Erebos has sent me to bring you back. One last time, no more replicants."
"I've always found the idea of replicants, multiple lives, so ABSURD! And it makes it far worse that you never once took the time to value any of them."

Ivys, you are not feeling confusion, you are not, as you usually do, coming up with a hundred creative and magical ways to defeat this being, you are terrified. You feel so deeply within your soul that if you stay here you are going to die, and yet no matter how hard you try you cannot move your feet from the spot they are in.
